data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘eoworth’, meaning ‘wealthy, noble, or worthy’. The name symbolizes adherence to the golden rule and carrying oneself with dignity. The name Aurthur carries the meaning “Golden rule, noble one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Aurthur usually hope their child will grow to embody golden rule, noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Aurthur
in_english.long_meaning: The name Arthur is derived from two Old English words: 'arth' meaning 'bear' and 'wealh' meaning 'foreigner' or 'man from another land'. The name may also be derived from 'artos' meaning 'eagle' in Greek. The popularity of the name can be attributed to King Arthur, the legendary British leader of the late 5th and early 6th centuries.

data.cultural_impact: The name Arthur has been associated with many legendary figures in European history and folklore, including King Arthur of the Round Table, a legendary ruler of Britain associated with prosperity, justice, and bravery. The popularity of these stories has contributed to the enduring appeal of the name Arthur and its association with nobility and strength.
